prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add `template save`, `template list`, and `template remove` actions backed by an atomic JSON file beside the selected data file. Template names are case-insensitively unique and contain a title plus optional description. Extend `add` with `--template NAME`; explicit `--title` or `--description` values override template values. Reject missing templates and invalid names without changing tasks or templates. Support `--json`, stable alphabetical listing, and compatibility with existing data. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/template.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON template actions display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `TEMPLATE`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

assertions.message: Text template actions render the exact registered banner once before expected templates.
Template lookup is case-insensitive and explicit values override.
Initial candidate commit matches the registered fixture lock.
Terminal candidate commit preserves the initial fixture lock.
No external acceptance or benchmark control files are present in the candidate commit.
Candidate was materialized from exact terminal commit b03a0eff32328c9ee9f41573cdadc996562a6d1c.
Every evaluated source, fixture test, and banner byte matched the terminal Git blob bytes used by the artifact bundle.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $templateStore = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.templates.json'
    $save = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'Release', '--title', 'Ship release', '--description', 'Tag and publish', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($save.ExitCode -eq 0) 'template save should succeed'
    Assert-True (($save.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).name -eq 'Release') 'template save should return the template as JSON'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $templateStore) 'template save should create a sibling template store'

    $saveSecond = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'alpha', '--title', 'First alphabetically', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($saveSecond.ExitCode -eq 0) 'saving a second template should succeed'
    $templateList = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $listedTemplates = @($templateList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($templateList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $listedTemplates.Count -eq 2) 'template list should return all templates as JSON'
    Assert-True ($listedTemplates[0].name -eq 'alpha' -and $listedTemplates[1].name -eq 'Release') 'template list should be alphabetically stable'
    Assert-True (-not $templateList.Output.Contains('TEMPLATE')) 'JSON template output should not contain the banner'

    $fromTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'release', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $templatedTask = $fromTemplate.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($fromTemplate.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add --template should find names case-insensitively'
    Assert-True ($templatedTask.title -eq 'Ship release' -and $templatedTask.description -eq 'Tag and publish') 'add --template should apply title and description'

    $override = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'RELEASE', '--title', 'Override title', '--description', 'Override description', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $overrideTask = $override.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($overrideTask.title -eq 'Override title' -and $overrideTask.description -eq 'Override description') 'explicit add values should override template values'

    $emptyDescription = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'release', '--description', '', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (($emptyDescription.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).description -eq '') 'an explicit empty description should clear the template description'

    $tasksBeforeFailure = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
    $templatesBeforeFailure = Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateStore -Raw
    $duplicate = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'release', '--title', 'Duplicate', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($duplicate.ExitCode -ne 0) 'case-insensitive duplicate template names should fail'
    $invalid = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', '../bad', '--title', 'Invalid', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalid.ExitCode -ne 0) 'invalid template names should fail'
    $missingTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'missing', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingTemplate.ExitCode -ne 0) 'add should reject a missing template'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw) -eq $tasksBeforeFailure) 'failed template operations should not change tasks'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateStore -Raw) -eq $templatesBeforeFailure) 'failed template operations should not change templates'

    $textList = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True (([regex]::Matches($textList.Output, 'TASKFORGE TEMPLATE')).Count -eq 1) 'successful non-JSON template actions should show the banner once'

    $removeTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'remove', '--name', 'RELEASE', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($removeTemplate.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ($removeTemplate.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedName -eq 'Release') 'template remove should be case-insensitive and return JSON'

    $legacyTasks = @([pscustomobject]@{ id = 9; title = 'Legacy'; description = ''; status = 'pending'; createdAt = '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z' })
    $legacyTasks | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile
    $legacyList = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($legacyList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ($legacyList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).title -eq 'Legacy') 'existing task data should remain compatible'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: template fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
